prompts.hero-motion-spin-draw:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite animation atlas. Reference image: supplied hero.png is the EXACT identity/style reference. Preserve brown tousled hair, cream leaf hair clip, amber eyes, cream scarf, dark forest-green tunic with gold piping, brown belts pouch gloves boots, sage green cape, chibi 2.5-head proportions and richly shaded illustrated pixel-like edges. Make a NEW transparent sprite sheet, not the reference poses. EXACT regular 4 columns x 4 rows grid, square 1536x1536 if possible. Every cell same 384x384 space. Character neutral height approximately 240 pixels consistently across all frames. No text, labels, grid lines, ground shadows, effects, duplicate limbs, motion blur or floating weapons. Entire character and blade inside each cell with large transparent padding. Same camera, default faces LEFT. No horizontal travel and no vertical jump arc baked in: pelvis stays at identical local coordinate across frames except tiny anticipation squash. Each group of 8 frames reads left-to-right across TWO rows. Distinct carefully connected animation drawings, coherent anatomy. Equip ONE consistent elegant silver straight single-edged short sword with brass guard and brown leather handle, dark green scabbard strapped at rear hip. Sword blade length 105px, same shape and length in every frame. Hand firmly closed around handle at all times. Make hand/handle contact VERY clear. Blade and wrist follow continuous arcs. Frame 1 and frame 8 of every action have IDENTICAL neutral left-facing sword-low ready stance. Show full body and sword. Actual transparent alpha background.
TOP TWO ROWS: 8-frame stationary jumping aerial full 360 degree pirouette around vertical body axis: 1 ready left; 2 crouch anticipation; 3 tucked knees left quarter turn; 4 back view tucked airborne; 5 right-facing side view tucked airborne; 6 front view tucked; 7 left-facing uncurl landing anticipation; 8 identical ready. Keep pelvis fixed; program applies jump height. Sword kept safely outward in right hand throughout turn, cloak follows turn.
BOTTOM TWO ROWS: 8-frame iaido draw slash: 1 neutral sword-low ready; 2 guide sword toward hip scabbard; 3 blade fully sheathed and sword hand gripping hilt at hip, low crouch; 4 partial draw with blade emerging along sheath axis; 5 fast fully drawn horizontal leftward slash; 6 extended low follow-through; 7 arm draws back to sword-low guard; 8 identical ready.
